sentiment.instructions: These are Albanian (Kosovo dialect) Facebook comments on COVID-19 case updates from Kosovo's public health institute (IKSHP). Judge the commenter's attitude: support/hope versus distrust/anger, or neither.

criteria.positive: Praise, thanks, blessings, congratulations or hope: thanking doctors/IKSHP, wishing recovery, welcoming falling numbers, prayers. Constructive advice framed caringly (stay home, keep distance, proposals to institutions) also counts as positive. Cues: 'ju lumtë' (well done), 'bravo', 'respekt', 'urime' (congratulations), 'shërim të shpejtë' (speedy recovery), 'zoti ju ndihmoftë' (God help you), 'elhamdulilah/shyqyr' (thank God), 'lajm i mirë' (good news), 'inshallah'.
criteria.neutral: No clear sentiment: bare name tags of other users, questions asking for information (location, which town, why no table), factual statistics, jokes, banter or idle remarks about towns/numbers, predictions, neutral suggestions or emoji-only. Mild sarcasm or teasing without accusation stays neutral.
criteria.negative: Distrust, accusation, anger, insult, despair or conspiracy: claiming numbers are lies or manipulated, attacking government/politicians/parties, scolding irresponsible people, cursing, mocking with heavy laughter, calling it a 'plandemic'/propaganda, complaining about mismanagement. Cues: 'mos rreni' (don't lie), 'rrena/gënjeshtra' (lies), 'turp' (shame), 'zoti ju vraftë/mallkoftë' (God kill/curse you), 'qifsha' (vulgar curse), 'propagandë', 'manipuloni' (you manipulate), 'spo ju besoj' (I don't believe you), 'kuku', repeated 'STOP'.
